title: k-th largest element
statement: Return the k-th largest element of the array (in sorted order, not the k-th distinct). Try to beat sorting.
hints: Keep only the k largest seen so far.
Which of those k do you need to throw out when a new one arrives? The smallest: a min-heap.
complexity: O(n log k) heap; O(n) average quickselect

solution.explanation: A min-heap of size k holds the k largest so far; its top is the k-th largest. The counter-intuitive part, using a min-heap to find large values, is the whole trick: the heap's job is to know what to evict. Quickselect (partition around a random pivot, recurse into one side) is O(n) on average; mention it, and nth_element in C++.
